Method of Attack: File read/include vulnerability allowing attackers to read configuration and source code files
Remote code execution via malicious JSP script code upload and inclusion exploiting the vulnerability
Impacted Systems: Java-based servers and frameworks including Spring Boot, JBoss Web Server (JWS), JBoss Enterprise Application Platform (EAP)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Apache JServ Protocol (AJP) Connector enabled by default on port 8009
Mass scanning and exploitation of unpatched Tomcat servers
Indicators of Compromise: Over 890,000 Tomcat servers reachable over the Internet (Shodan)
Over 1 million Tomcat servers found by BinaryEdge
